detail: CvTdb export lacks strain and verified shared protocol; publication matches remain candidates. Dose-specific study IDs must not be conflated with independent publications.
No verified source-to-SMILES mapping collected; RDKit utility tested but molecular identity deduplication, descriptors and scaffolds cannot yet support ML.
Rat PMC AUC0-tn terminal times not confirmed per group; partial CvTdb AUC windows vary. No AUC benchmark produced.
PMC9316000 Table 2 duplicates 1.25 mg/kg headers and IV-like values; prose describes a 2.5 mg/kg group. No silent correction; all dog endpoints outside adapter scope.
Only one protocol-verified compound; no compound/scaffold-disjoint ML, calibrated intervals or independent nonlinear detection evaluation.
Current official download docs require an active account and substantial reuse has separate conditions; no authentication bypass attempted.
PKSmart dose series unverified; TG-GATEs catalog lacks systemic exposure table; FDA/EMA PDF extraction and additional PMC supplement collectors not implemented.
DOI/name/ID overlap screening is incomplete without structural and publication alias resolution. Identifier counts are not proven unique molecules.

Digitized curves, censoring, radiolabel uncertainty, individual versus summary data and assay quality need study-level review. Large source series count includes single-point series; no automated regrouping across them.
EPA original release CC0 and packaged CRAN GPL-3 are recorded separately; derived/raw datasets are not committed. Review distribution-specific obligations before publication.
